p.s: Dear, Sir/Madam
I am Writing this letter to say my dissatisfaction of your entertament.
Last week I was on holiday and I went to The Circle Theatre to see over the rainbow musical.
I was really looking forward to seeing it, because I like musical and also I like Danny Brook.
However, the reading actor was not him!
Of course, I was so disappointed.
The actor was not famous for his acting.
Also the musical did not start on time, it was late thirty minuts.
We just sat on the seat and nothing to do.
I was going to a restaurant with my friends after the musical, but the musical finished at ten thirty.
It was too late and we could not have a dinner.
If the musical had started on time, we could have eaten in the restaurant.
Fathermore, discounts was unavailable.

However, I need balance.
If I watch TV too much I might not speak to my family often.

I think I should cut down watching TV.
Sometimes it waste of time.
What about computers?
